kite-scope.purpose: Creates an isolated or inherited reactive state scope on a DOM element using native JavaScript Proxy.

kite-text.purpose: Sets the textContent of the element, automatically evaluating expressions and strictly HTML-escaping text.

kite-html.purpose: Sets the innerHTML of the element using the built-in sanitizer to prevent XSS injection.

kite-bind.purpose: Dynamically binds an HTML attribute or boolean property to an evaluated expression.

kite-model.purpose: Enables two-way data binding on inputs, textareas, checkboxes, radio buttons, and selects.

kite-for.purpose: Renders repeated elements dynamically over arrays, objects, or number ranges.

kite-if.purpose: Conditionally renders element into DOM if expression evaluates to truthy.

kite-else.purpose: Default fallback branch following kite-if or kite-elif.

kite-show.purpose: Toggles element visibility via CSS display: none without removing it from the DOM tree.

kite-on.purpose: Attaches event listeners with support for modifiers (prevent, stop, once, enter, escape, debounce, throttle).

kite-class.purpose: Toggles a specific CSS class when the expression evaluates to truthy.

kite-reset.purpose: Restores reactive scope state back to its initial initialized values on click.

kite-cloak.purpose: Hides uncompiled elements until Kite runtime finishes scanning to eliminate Flash of Unstyled Content (FOUC).

kite-skip.purpose: Instructs the Kite scanner to skip compiling the element and all of its descendants.

kite-persist.purpose: Syncs reactive scope state with localStorage or sessionStorage automatically.

kite-validate.purpose: Validates form fields with built-in or custom rules and publishes field errors.

kite-emit.purpose: Dispatches a custom DOM event on the element when the expression triggers.

kite-copy.purpose: Copies the evaluated text expression into the user clipboard on click.

kite-poll.purpose: Executes expression repeatedly at a specified time interval.

kite-shortcut.purpose: Binds a global keyboard shortcut to evaluate an expression.

kite-watch.purpose: Observes specific property mutations and executes a callback.

kite-init.purpose: Runs expression immediately once when the element is bound.

kite-computed.purpose: Calculates and maintains reactive derived state values on the scope.

kite-format.purpose: Formats text contents of an element as date, formatted number, or currency.

kite-component.purpose: Defines a reusable template component with isolated scope, props, and slots.

kite-use.purpose: Instantiates a declared component, passing props and slot projections.

slot.purpose: Defines default or named content injection targets inside a <kite-component> template.

kite-model.purpose: Defines a named global reactive data model with initial state, methods, and optional API adapter bindings.

kite-view.purpose: Binds a DOM subtree to a named model scope or serves as a routable template target.

kite-controller.purpose: Encapsulates named event action handlers for a model directly in HTML.

kite-route.purpose: Declares client-side hash routing rules mapping URL hash paths to view templates.

kite-outlet.purpose: DOM container where currently active route views are mounted.

kite-api.purpose: Declarative REST/fetch client definition with base URL and default headers.

kite-store.purpose: Global shared reactive store accessible across all components and views.

kite-config.purpose: Configures runtime options (CSP, cloak, logging, autoScan) declaratively.

kite-include.purpose: Inlines HTML partial files into the document shell at build time or development.

Kite.directive.signature: Kite.directive(name: string, handler: Function, opts?: Object): Function
Kite.directive.purpose: Registers a custom directive with priority, watchers, and unregister return.

Kite.helper.signature: Kite.helper(name: string, fn: Function, opts?: Object): Function
Kite.helper.purpose: Registers an expression helper callable in templates.

Kite.adapter.signature: Kite.adapter(name: string, handler: Function | Object): Function
Kite.adapter.purpose: Registers a custom HTTP or protocol adapter for API clients.

Kite.middleware.purpose: Registers an API client request/response interceptor.

Kite.model.signature: Kite.model(name: string, state?: Object, api?: string | Object): Proxy
Kite.model.purpose: Creates or retrieves a named reactive model proxy.

Kite.view.signature: Kite.view(name: string, templateHtml?: string, modelName?: string): Object
Kite.view.purpose: Registers or retrieves a named view template.

Kite.route.purpose: Registers a client-side hash route programmatically.

Kite.store.purpose: Creates or retrieves a named global reactive store.

Kite.config.signature: Kite.config(optsOrKey?: Object | string, val?: any): any
Kite.config.purpose: Reads or updates global runtime configuration.

Kite.override.purpose: Replaces a built-in directive while preserving the original.

Kite.original.purpose: Retrieves the original implementation of an overridden directive.

Kite.inspect.purpose: Introspects registered directives, helpers, stores, and element bindings.

Kite.state.purpose: Reads or walks dot-separated state across all models and stores.

Kite.scan.purpose: Scans and compiles DOM tree with Kite reactive directives.

Kite.navigate.purpose: Navigates to a client-side hash route programmatically.

Kite.evaluate.purpose: Safely evaluates an expression string against a scope without eval.

capitalize.purpose: Capitalizes the first character of string.

currency.purpose: Formats number as USD currency string ($XX.XX).

json.purpose: Serializes value to formatted JSON string.

navigate.purpose: Helper to trigger client-side hash navigation.
